mapper.select: select p.user_num, p.stock_code, s.stock_name, p.user_stock_cnt, p.user_buy_cost from t_portfolio p join t_stock s on s.stock_code = p.stock_code where p.user_num = #{userNum} order by p.stock_code
select s.stock_name from t_portfolio p join t_stock s on s.stock_code = p.stock_code where p.user_num = #{userNum}
select * from t_portfolio where user_num = #{userNum} and stock_code = #{stockCode}
mapper.insert: insert into t_portfolio(user_num, stock_code, user_stock_cnt, user_buy_cost) values ( #{userNum}, #{stockCode}, #{userStockCnt}, #{userBuyCost} )
mapper.delete: delete from t_portfolio where user_num = #{userNum} and stock_code = #{stockCode}
mapper.update: merge into t_portfolio using dual on (user_num = #{userNum} and stock_code = #{stockCode}) when matched then update set user_stock_cnt = user_stock_cnt + #{userStockCnt}, user_buy_cost = user_buy_cost + #{userBuyCost} when not matched then insert (user_num, stock_code, user_stock_cnt, user_buy_cost) values (#{userNum}, #{stockCode}, #{userStockCnt}, #{userBuyCost})
